title: Schedule of Minimum Late Fees by Tenure, Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
**Minimum late fee — Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement.**

| Tenure on the agreement (whole calendar months from the start date to the handling date) | Minimum late fee |
|---|---|
| 36 months or more | $10.00 |
| 12 months or more but fewer than 36 | $15.00 |
| fewer than 12 months | no adjustment under this schedule |

For a tenant in either of the first two rows, the late fee is never less than the minimum shown, and that minimum is the only floor the fee is held to: when the fee as otherwise worked out is lower, it is raised to the minimum; when it is higher, it stands. The minimum is compared with the fee last, once every other part of the late-fee calculation has been applied, and the result is rounded to the cent.

Months are counted to the same day of the later month, or that month's last day when the day does not exist; the boundaries are inclusive (36 months exactly is in the first row, 12 months exactly in the second).

### Hypothetical readings

- Tenure 40 months, fee otherwise worked out at $6.40: raised to $10.00.
- Tenure 40 months, fee otherwise worked out at $13.20: stands at $13.20, even where that is below the class's flat late fee.
- Tenure 18 months, fee otherwise worked out at $11.00: raised to $15.00.
- Tenure 18 months, fee otherwise worked out at $42.00: stands at $42.00.
